test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Priya washes her clothes in the evening.

options.text: The clothes was washed by Priya in the evening.
The clothes are washed by Priya in the evening.
The clothes is washed by Priya in the evening.
The clothes were washed by Priya in the evening.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The clothes are washed by Priya in the evening."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice.
 
• As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V1(s/es) + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ is/am/are + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *She shows them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Some rare photographs are shown by her. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject **"Priya"** performing the action of washing her clothes.
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object **"her clothes"** the subject of the sentence and use a form of **"be" (in this case, "are")** and the past participle of the verb **(in this case, "washed")**.
 
• The agent (the one performing the action) is introduced with** "by"** at the end of the sentence, in this case** "by Priya".**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
